detectorTooltips.symmetry: Measures facial and object asymmetry. AI tends to create artificially perfect symmetry.
detectorTooltips.stats: Analyzes pixel value distribution. AI images have statistically distinct histogram patterns.
detectorTooltips.fft: Detects periodic frequency patterns via Fast Fourier Transform — common in AI-generated images.
detectorTooltips.texture: Compares textures to natural surfaces. AI tends to produce artificially smooth textures without imperfections.
detectorTooltips.shadow: Checks if shadows originate from a consistent light source. AI often generates physically impossible shadows.
detectorTooltips.ela: Error Level Analysis: detects JPEG compression inconsistencies that indicate editing or digital generation.
detectorTooltips.gradient: Analyzes image edges. AI produces artificially uniform edges without organic camera noise.
detectorTooltips.exif: Camera metadata (make, model, GPS). AI-generated images rarely contain real camera EXIF data.
detectorTooltips.noise: Electronic sensor noise is unique to each real camera. AI generates artificial noise with different patterns.
detectorTooltips.temporal: Video only. Compares consecutive frames to detect abnormal transitions or artificial flicker.
detectorTooltips.platformLabel: AI detection label provided by the source platform (e.g., TikTok's AI-generated content filter).
detectorTooltips.hive: Hive Moderation API — proprietary model trained on billions of AI-generated content examples.
detectorTooltips.sightengine: Sightengine API — specialized in deepfakes and face manipulation in images and videos.
detectorTooltips.transformers: Local ViT model running on the server, without sending data to external APIs.
